name_en: Katsuo no Tataki — bonito seared over an open flame, then salted and slapped by hand
summary_ja: 3枚におろしたカツオを藁などであぶり、厚めの刺身にして塩を振って手でたたき、柚子酢や醤油のたれをかける。船上のまかないが始まりとされ、皿鉢料理の定番として地域や家庭ごとに味付けが違うという。
summary_en: Bonito is filleted, seared over an open flame (traditionally straw), sliced thick, salted, slapped by hand, and dressed with a yuzu-vinegar or soy sauce. Said to have started as food fishermen made on board, it's a fixture of sawachi platters, with the finishing touch varying by area and household.
source_title: かつおのたたき 高知県 | うちの郷土料理：農林水産省
